column1: ALL PATHS, COMPILERS AND COMMANDS ARE THE ACTUAL EXECUTED SUBJECTS
Every field in this table names the executable that was actually run,
the source that was actually compiled and the object that was actually
produced.  The G0 producer is the HOST C COMPILER because the G0
component object is a C build; the G1..G3 producers are the three
PolyC compilers, each of which is a DISTINCT binary.
